integrity: Fully specified finite arithmetic and a reproducible spanning-tree triangle-closure certificate; the independent external audit has not been performed.
limitations: A rational representation for the 136 affine symmetries of the Paley-17 flag complex, not an integral equivariant splitting or an all-Paley theorem. The nonequivariant wedge type follows from prior vertex-decomposability work.
title: The affine augmentation representation of the Paley-seventeen flag complex
